forward_assumptions._note: Forward assumptions for the layer engine (engine/layers.py). v1.0 / CORRECTED do not read this section. Levels: for layer assumptions 'low' gives customers a SMALLER shared-savings effect and 'high' a LARGER one. For growth assumptions (projection, system_needs, capacity price growth) low/high = lower/higher growth. Scenarios (Cautious / Central / Ambitious) set the programs, deferral and load_enabled layers together and hold growth assumptions and the utility share at central.

Cautious.description: Today's programs grown modestly, no flexible connections, high cost per kW-year, low locational match; growth and utility share central.

Central.description: Every assumption at central; flexible MW anchored to VCEA storage target and Dominion IRP DSM forecast.

Ambitious.description: DOE national range (20% of peak) or the state anchor if higher, low cost per kW-year, high locational match, more flexible connections; growth and utility share central.
